topArticle.title: Spain’s PM says no evidence ‘whatsoever’ Morocco behind Ceuta border breach
topArticle.description:
Pedro Sánchez continues to defend Rabat after police report claiming border forces helped 70,000 cross border

Europe live – latest updates

Spain has seen no evidence “whatsoever” that Morocco planned or facilitated a mass border breach into its north African territory of Ceuta, the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has told parliament.
The address on Thursday followed the emergence of a police report, commissioned by a judge and widely quoted in the media, claiming Moroccan border forces had actively aided about 70,000 people to cross the border in late July.

Guinea-Bissau voters have approved a new constitution, which critics say will undermine democracy, that significantly expands presidential powers ahead of elections due in December.

topArticle.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
topArticle.description: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.

topArticle.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
topArticle.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.

topArticle.summary: ニカラグアで、権威主義的政権が市民権を武器化し、反体制派を沈黙させるために国籍剥奪を正当化する物語を検証する。

topArticle.title: Eleven people sentenced to death in Vietnam drug trafficking case

topArticle.title: Why US troops have a history in this raucous Thai city

topArticle.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice
topArticle.description: On 2 September 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 31 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of hulled rice, semi-whitened or whitened rice, polished or glazed, and broken rice.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の種類の米に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルは2026年9月2日、玄米、精米、砕米などの特定の種類の米の輸入に対し、セーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報しました。

topArticle.title: WTO members adopt panel report regarding EU duties on fatty acid from Indonesia
topArticle.description: At a meeting on 28 August of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB), WTO members adopted a panel report regarding the European Union’s anti-dumping duties on imports of fatty acid from Indonesia.
topArticle.titleJa: WTO加盟国、インドネシア産脂肪酸に対するEU関税に関するパネル報告書を採択
